_comment: Example Delphi-compatible config for a new project.
_comment_top_level: Keep top-level keys: name, seed, data, model, optimizer, trainer, extra.
_comment_paths: data.path can be absolute and point outside Delphi (recommended for multi-project datasets).
name: my_experiment

data._comment: Required conventions: batch_size > 0, train_split in (0,1), and a valid path.

model._comment: These keys are forwarded as kwargs to MyModel.__init__. Replace with your architecture-specific parameters.

trainer._comment: Trainer settings. Device can be auto/cpu/cuda.

inference._comment: Run epoch-end inference updates in GUI. Set every_epochs=0 to disable.

extra._comment_project_folder: Preferred: set project_folder to models/<ProjectName> to resolve train.py, infer.py, and local trainer_factory.py.
extra._comment_project_name: Used by GUI to resolve models/<project_name>/train.py and models/<project_name>/infer.py.
extra._comment_entrypoints: Optional explicit script overrides relative to Delphi root.
extra._comment_factory: trainer_factory_path determines the actual model/data/trainer wiring.
extra._comment_factory_contract: Optional contract object consumed by your project factory for strict validation.

components._comment: Optional component-driven wiring (used when extra.trainer_factory_path = core/component_factory.py).
components._comment_refs: You can reference values via $section.key, e.g. $loss.label_smoothing.
